parameters.projectile_rule: Ambient resistance may perturb valid trajectories but does not replace Returning Current or Flowing Veil and never automatically neutralizes projectiles.
parameters.crosscurrent_rule: Does not grant full Crosscurrent Zone fine-control effects for free; Crosscurrent remains a separate paid technique.
parameters.binding_rule: Does not grant Binding Current for free; focused restraint is broader, more expensive, and opposed.
